name: A. Burnham
role: Member of a party on the Spearfish-Medora freight route
mentions: …ll. The road was dry and dusty from that point to Belle Fourche, where we arrived at 5 P. M. Here we found A. Burnham with a force of ten men and five of Mr. T. G. Jones' teams, constructing a bridge across the Belle Fourche river. The bridge will be finished by April 10 at a cost of $1…
